name: @emsenn/jsnode-codecs
description: Factual RDF codec for the JS Node package ecosystem: JSNodePackage and JSNodeWorkspace carriers as Turtle and JSON-LD over a plain-triple vocabulary.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run audit:boundary
